page: Google Cloud Platform a3-megagpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized server designed for high-density compute and memory workloads. It features 208 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8481C processors with an x86_64 architecture, operating at 2.7 GHz across 104 physical cores. The system is equipped with 1872.0 GB of system memory, providing 9.0 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it integrates eight NVIDIA H100 GPUs from the Hopper family, delivering a combined 640 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of 16 NVMe SSDs totaling 6432 GB.

Benchmark data highlights top-tier performance across multiple domains. In multi-core CPU testing, the stress-ng multi-core score and PassMark CPU score rank in the top 10%. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 13,667.21 GB/sec and large block uncached speeds at 430.55 GB/sec, both placing in the top 10%. The server also demonstrates top-tier database capabilities, achieving 180.65 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and high throughput in PassMark database operations. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core CPU and PassMark memory scores falling into the middle 50% average category.

Given its massive hardware footprint, this server represents a high-resource-density profile with corresponding qualitative cost considerations. It is optimized for large-scale parallel processing rather than single-threaded efficiency. The presence of advanced CPU instruction sets like Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) enhances its mathematical and cryptographic processing capabilities. This server is best suited for large language model (LLM) training and inference, high-performance computing (HPC), ray tracing, large-scale database operations, and intensive data science workloads.
